recognize_zh: 一群中等大小、形態單一的淋巴細胞，胞質深藍色且布滿大小一致、邊界清楚的圓形透明脂質空泡，核圓、染色質細點狀，這是Burkitt細胞（FAB L3）的典型樣貌。
features: Cluster of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous sharply punched-out round clear vacuoles
Vacuoles present in both cytoplasm and overlying the nucleus
Round to oval nuclei with finely stippled chromatin and small indistinct nucleoli
Moderate N:C ratio with a narrow but distinct rim of dark blue cytoplasm
describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely stippled chromatin and small nucleoli. The cells have a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm studded with numerous sharply defined round clear vacuoles, some overlying the nucleus. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia (FAB L3 morphology); confirmation of a mature B-cell immunophenotype (CD10+, BCL2 negative, Ki-67 near 100%) and MYC rearrangement is required.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts may have occasional vacuoles but have scant pale cytoplasm and are TdT positive and surface immunoglobulin negative, unlike TdT-negative, sIg-positive Burkitt cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic, and double-hit lymphoma requires FISH for MYC with BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangements.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular vacuoles and folded nuclei and are MPO/NSE and CD14/CD64 positive.
